method.pageCoverage: Every physical page6–101 was visually inspected, not sampled. Primary data pages were opened individually at the regenerated full-page resolution; remaining drawings/dividers were inspected in legible contact sheets. method.numericCoverage: Every populated primary technical/dimension table row and its transcribed values/units were compared against source pixels. This is a full table-cell review, not a numeric sample. Merged cells, tap sequences, slash pairs and connection options were checked in their printed row scope. Drawing dimension tables75/97 were checked in full; redundant drawing H tables96/98 were checked.
method.limits: Free-standing numeric dimension annotations and terminal-detail annotations within drawings were reviewed as illustration evidence but were not exhaustively re-transcribed or certified for CAD. No engineering plausibility corrections were substituted for printed source values. Compiled inventory/proposal/application were absent after recovery and are outside the completed sectional consistency verification.
